verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI lets users choose which external integrations the agent gets by configuring MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json. It also offers /tools and /mcp commands to inspect available tools and servers. That gives some first-party control over integration access, but nothing shows granular permissioning or policy enforcement aimed at an engineering lead. missing for 10: documented per-tool allow/deny lists, approval or confirmation policies for tool calls, team or organization-level enforcement of allowed integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access

citations.quote: Configure MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend Gemini CLI with custom tools
Use MCP servers to connect new capabilities
